statement: Pinned Dolphin Wii Remote emulation declares two accelerometer calibration blocks of 10 bytes each in its emulated EEPROM, following two 11-byte IR blocks: offsets 0x0016 and 0x0020. Its synthesized accelerometer template reserves three axes' zero-g data, one reserved byte, three axes' one-g data, two further bytes and a final one-byte checksum. These are emulator field conventions, not per-device factory calibration values.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: WiimoteEmu.h 257-268; WiimoteEmu.cpp 137-144; checksum computed by common source helper. Physical internal precision, valid calibration values and alternate layouts unmeasured.
